variables.name: BODY_LIMIT
variables.description: Largest JSON request body express will parse, e.g. "1mb"; nginx client_max_body_size must be at least this

variables.name: TRUST_PROXY_CIDRS
variables.description: Comma-separated trusted proxy IP addresses or CIDRs; empty ignores forwarded headers. Configure only actual proxy peers.

variables.name: CORS_ORIGINS
variables.description: Comma-separated browser origins allowed to read API responses; "*" allows any, empty allows none (same-origin only)

variables.name: CORS_CREDENTIALS
variables.description: Emit Access-Control-Allow-Credentials for browser credential mode; does not enable cookie authentication or CSRF protection (cannot be combined with CORS_ORIGINS=*)

variables.name: HSTS_MAX_AGE
variables.description: Strict-Transport-Security max-age in seconds; 0 disables the header (browsers only honour it over HTTPS)

variables.name: RATE_LIMIT_NAMESPACE
variables.description: Stable identifier shared by replicas; use a different value for unrelated apps on the same Redis database

variables.name: RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_MS
variables.description: Fixed request window in milliseconds; positive integer, applied on restart

variables.name: AUTH_RATE_LIMIT
variables.description: Combined login, register and password POST attempts per client per window; positive integer

variables.name: AUTH_SESSION_RATE_LIMIT
variables.description: All auth requests per client per window, including refresh and credential attempts; positive integer

variables.name: SETTINGS_RATE_LIMIT
variables.description: All settings requests per client per window; positive integer
